summary: DNS of the static cylinder (amplitude A = 0) at Re = 100 on the mesh of the moving-cylinder case, with sponge and filter. The reference checks the frequency and the amplitude of the late probe signal.
description: Late-window dominant frequency and amplitude of v at the probe (5, 0) of 1cyl.his. userParam05 = 0, so the mesh does not move; the frequency 0.1663 is the Strouhal number of the static cylinder on this mesh. The forced stages use f = 0.1643, 1.2 % lower (see 010_dns_forced).
